name: Kanban Draft Vault
changes: Retention limits and the search field of draft recovery can now be selected without Pro. They show how to get Pro, with a Sponsor on GitHub button, and change nothing.
tip: Run Open draft recovery to find text kept from a new-card form closed with Escape or a click outside.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Kanban Draft Vault is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to keep your card drafts safe.
